name: Val de San Lorenzo (Spain)
description: Divided into three triangles from the fly, yellow above, red in the centre and green below.
history: Municipal flag of Val de San Lorenzo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle along the upper edge from the upper hoist to the middle of the fly
triangle along the lower edge from the lower hoist to the middle of the fly
central triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the middle of the fly
